name: labwc
summary: No AI-generated content in code, issues, discussions or PR descriptions. AI may be used for research, static analysis or debugging if its output isn't included; translation must use non-generative tools.

evidence.quote: We do not accept contributions containing AI-generated content.
This policy does not apply to other uses of AI, such as researching APIs, performing static analysis, or debugging, provided their output is not included in contributions.
This stance does not just apply to code, but also issues, discussions and PR descriptions.
If you are not a native English speaker and need assistance with translations, please use a tool which doesn't use generative AI.
